item.content:encoded:
First attempt, my brain turned to mush from Cack.

Upvoting, going back and playing more.

Since there is no way to edit in corrections to Twine (at least that I know of), I'll be posting errors here as I see them. Hopefully they're not that hard to find since I don't have page numbers to work with.

+ show block
– hide block

From the page "Let's review the facts:"

If your higher-ups that you've breached the containment of a Euclid-class anomaly, "demoted to D-class" would be the best-case scenario.

Missing a word between "higher-ups" and "that", I'm assuming.

From Ending #6.

Finaly, "…am… pidge?" says your target.

"Finaly" to "Finally".

COURIER: PRESENTED SITE-59 WITH A CONTERFEIT ANOMALY;

"CONTERFEIT" to "COUNTERFEIT".

From Ending #10

"Swampoodles?! And HOW, pleasenthankens! It am the dampening, cack, so claimeth I the deep-end ant!"

I don't know how, but this isn't italicized in the Twine.

RE-CONTAINED ON SCHEDULED

I feel like "SCHEDULED" is unintentionally past-tense.

item.title: Press X to cack
item.content:encoded:
So, a few notes:

- 10 different endings. Only one is a successful re-contain.
- Done in Twine.
- The part with "mangoberry" is a partial parody of the T.S. Eliot poem "Macavity the Mystery Cat." …jus'sayin'.
- Cack.
